text:
jana: quick sync on envelope approach for attr propagation — goal: let teams opt-in high-card billing attrs while keeping queries robust.

vik: starting point: minimal trace attrs globally (service, env, trace_id) + optional envelope payload for extras.

oliver: what does the envelope look like? can we compress/sketch it before sending to ingest?

jana: thinking small: envelope.version, envelope.src, envelope.flags, envelope.attrs[] where attrs can be marked high/low-card. example: 

```
{ envelope.version: 1, envelope.src: "sdk-v2", envelope.buckets: ["country","tenant_id"], attrs: [{k:"tenant_id",v:"acct-42",tier:"high"}] }
```

li: two concerns: (1) if billing key not attached, how do queries resolve cost? (2) sampling: if we drop high-card attrs during sampling, attribution breaks.

vik: we can provide best-effort billing resolution via service-level lookup table: map service->billing_key when envelope missing. degrade gracefully.

jana: agreed. also we should record provenance metadata so audit can say whether attribution came from envelope or lookup.

ops-bot: note: recent canary telemetry retained 0.9% more storage when envelope.v1 was enabled.

oliver: can we run pre-ingest filters that rewrite the envelope and drop values for hosted tenants flagged as PII? that keeps compliance surface small.

li: yes but need a policy registry — allowlist of attrs that hosted pipeline may persist. private deployments can bypass that.

vik: rollout strategy idea: SDKs default to attaching envelope meta only (no values). teams call attachEnvelopeValues() to opt into full values; console flag "billing-authorized" flips experience per service.

jana: and add a diagnostic query that finds "ghost costs": high-cost services without billing attr footprints for last 7 days, alert owners. helps catch teams who forgot to opt-in.

oliver: what about sampling interplay? propose: when sampling traces, preserve envelope.meta and a hashed bucket id for high-card attrs so we can attribute proportionally. e.g., keep hash(tenant_id) and sample rate metadata.

li: hashing + bucketing helps for rollups but we must document limits: exact per-tenant billing queries won't be possible from hashed samples. only aggregate costs.

gov-team: compliance note: hashed identifiers must be irreversible and logged as such. obtain legal signoff if hashing deterministically links across datasets.

vik: POC tasks: (1) draft envelope spec with v1 fields (vik), (2) SDK change to emit meta-only by default (tbd, oliver), (3) pre-ingest policy service design (li).

jana: timeline: POC for internal teams in 2 weeks, pilot with billing/cust-eng in week 3. keystones: demo query that shows "attributed vs inferred" split.

ops-bot: created ticket INFRA-784 for envelope spec + pilot.

jana: ok team — I'll collate notes into an RFC appendix and include example queries + monitoring rules. thanks! :sparkles:
